meta.title: Acme Unslop Audit
meta.lede: Sixty agents read three months of session history, 400 open issues, CI runs, production telemetry and the code. They produced 20 proposals; each was checked against the data and then attacked by a skeptic. The diagnosis: the factory produces signals nobody trusts. CI is red for infrastructure reasons, logs are mostly noise, and old tickets never drain.
meta.method: Method: 17 scout lanes, a synthesis lead, a deep-dive and a skeptic per candidate, and a completeness critic. Every production and tracker call was read-only.

rules.title: Gates live in code, not in skill prose
rules.text: If a rule can be skipped, agents under deadline skip it.
rules.evidence: The test-evidence rule is followed by 1 in 8 merged PRs (C01).

rules.title: Queues need aging and WIP limits
rules.text: Agents pick the newest ticket, so the backlog becomes a landfill.
rules.evidence: 48% of agent tickets are older than 60 days; 2% of closures come from them (C02).
